text:
Alex: Quick standup — yesterday I finished the routing policy test harness and ran a few integrations; found a regression where internal healthchecks were blocked by the new default rule.
Priya: Ack. Which rule specifically?
Alex: The new global default "deny-unmatched" was evaluated before the service-account allow-list check, so infra probes hit 403. Repro: 
```
curl -i -H 'X-Service: infra-health' https://api-gw.internal/health
HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
```
Mateo: That would explain autoscaler flapping. Any short-term mitigation?
Alex: Hotfix plan: reorder policy evaluation so service-account allows run before default deny. I opened a PR: https://github.com/rw-inference/gateway/pull/498 (small patch).
Sam: I'll take staging deploy and smoke the probes once CI is green. @deploy-bot can you kick staging after CI?
deploy-bot: CI passed for commit 6f2a8c3 — staging deploy queued :rocket:
Priya: Blockers: none from my side, but we need perf numbers for the reorder. Alex, can you run a 10m perf run and share latency/token breakdown?
Alex: On it — running 10m at qps=50, will post results in ~12m.
Mateo: I'll own the rollout monitoring (429/503 alerts). If we see a spike, I'll cut back evaluation order and revert.
Sam: Today I'll finish the canary for the rate-limit tweak (shard token buckets) and update the SLO doc with expected token consumption charts.
Alex: Quick note — added a small unit test for policy merge edge cases. Might be handy if you review @Priya.
Priya: Will review after standup.
Alex: Done for now. Will paste perf snapshot when run completes. :eyes:
